The HWPX event announcement automation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust integration with the legacy pytest suite.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.79 across one trial with zero exceptions. The pytest tool (version 7.4.4) confirmed success via test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite in 0.116 seconds. While the orchestration was successful, the discrepancy between the verifier and judge rewards suggests potential for further optimization in output quality or alignment.
